metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Typed Paradox Enumeration (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: RTT7 Gate • SPEC‑008 • Measure IDs • Session Safety
metadata.description: Defines the canonical paradox types, event schema, and validation rules for RTT7 entry and harmonic escalation.

status_line: Only typed paradox events may trigger RTT7; vibe-based paradox is forbidden.

paradox_types.description: A triad cannot resolve to a stable (T,S,M) tuple under declared invariants.
Two active claims produce incompatible metric values or lineage states.
Operator consent state contradicts escalation request or AA-level transition.
Session fields drift across files or projections (state, log, alignments) without lineage continuity.

field_definitions.event_id: Unique identifier for the paradox event.
field_definitions.paradox_type: One of the canonical paradox types defined above.
field_definitions.rtt_node: RTT node where the paradox was detected.

validation_rules.typed_only: Paradox MUST be one of the canonical types; no invented types allowed.
validation_rules.rtt7_gate: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
validation_rules.lineage_non_decreasing: Session lineage MUST NOT decrease after paradox handling.

rtt7_entry_contract.notes: RTT7 is the paradox seed node; typed paradox is mandatory.

collapse_alignment.rtt12_rule: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
collapse_alignment.continuity_requirement: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across collapse.
